sample_unit: clinicians (physicians and advanced practice providers completing pre and post surveys)

links.outcome: Clinician burnout and professional fulfillment (Stanford PFI) before and after ambient scribe pilot
links.effect: Median burnout score improved from 4.16 to 3.16 (p = 0.005); burnout rate fell from 69 to 43%; interpersonal disengagement 3.6 vs 2.5 (p<0.001); work exhaustion and fulfillment (6.1 vs 6.5, p=0.10) not significant.
links.quote: Results showed a significant reduction in burnout scores, with the median burnout score improving from 4.16 to 3.16 (p = 0.005), with validated Stanford PFI cut-off for overall burnout of 3.33.

links.outcome: Clinician burnout measured with validated instrument after AI scribe deployment
links.effect: Burnout rates decreased from 69 to 43% and median burnout score fell from 4.16 to 3.16 (p = 0.005) on the Stanford PFI.

screen.reason: Evaluates the impact of a commercial ambient AI documentation tool on clinician burnout and professional fulfillment in real clinical deployment (pre-post study).
